rv.q: With its niche in-jokes and playfully deranged musical numbers, it’s the perfect tonic to the constant barrage of bad news to which we’re all exposed on a daily basis.
Nonetheless, The High Life:The Musical is a hilarious, camp and fun production which soars from take off until landing, transporting passengers both old and new on a fun ride through sunny skies.
The fun never stops but the clever lines so prevalent in act one lose their sharpness in a sea of ginger-haired chaos.

cn.t: The cult 90s Scottish comedy soars in its stage debut with fourth-wall-breaking madness, infectious energy, and exquisitely ridiculous humor that delights fans and newcomers alike.
